correctness.rationale: For all n>=k>=r>=1, fixed point upper bound is proved using explicit F(s)=max_m{mr-(mk-s)_+}, its 1-Lipschitzness and superadditivity. Reverse bound uses q disjoint k-sets plus one overlapping k-set, and a k-extension for smaller S. Perfect coherence reduces exactly to at most k-r omitted elements. Direct independent enumeration passed 5630 subset cases on n<=7. Boundary r=k and s<k covered.

value.rationale: This complete natural all-k-subset partial-conjunction family gives exact certified-discovery profiles for every queried S, contrasting a cheap iterative closure with full logical closure; the sharp k/r gap can be arbitrarily large and the absolute unreported number grows linearly in n. The all-parameter law is motivated by simultaneous true-discovery guarantees and is not just a restatement of the published n=3 example.
